name: Quote ops
blurb: Assess · Integrate · Accelerate for Quote It Away. Intake, agent match, 7-day vetting, nudges, billing alerts, admin exceptions. Bind stays off. Collect stays HOLD.

face.how: Draft the next ops step. Match and vetting wait on Yes. Bind stays off. Stripe Collect stays HOLD. You still tap.

help: Assess: map intake, match, vetting, nudges, billing, and admin friction onto Queue cards.
Integrate: Playbook A quote→match, Playbook B agent vetting (7 business days), Playbook C admin exceptions.
Accelerate: lock repeatable rules and KPIs. Desk AIs draft only. Humans tap Yes, Stop, or Kill.
Customer quote intake drafts a packet workspace — never invents premium or bind.
Agent dispatch and vetting approval wait on owner Yes. No silent route. No silent Stripe charge.
rails: Bind stays off the desk. Drop cannot bind coverage or invent premium.
Agent match dispatch waits on owner Yes. Desk AIs only draft the match note.
Agent vetting approve / deny waits on owner Yes. Target: within 7 business days.
Stripe subscription, trial, and renewal alerts draft only. Collect stays HOLD until Yes + a real money pipe.
In-platform nudges and SLA escalations draft on the card. Nothing sends itself.
Admin digests and exception cards draft only. Moderation stays an owner tap.
Public drop never sees People, Stop, money, license numbers, or medical detail.

rules.text: Queue admin on API quote failure.

ais.name: Intake AI
ais.does: Drafts quote intake packets and coverage baselines. Nothing sent. No premium invented.
ais.prompt: Draft ready. I cannot send, pay, or bind anything. You stay in control.

ais.name: Match AI
ais.does: Drafts agent match notes by line, territory, and capacity. Dispatch waits on Yes.
ais.prompt: Draft ready. I cannot send, pay, or bind anything. You stay in control.

ais.name: Vetting AI
ais.does: Drafts vetting checklists and 7-day SLA reminders. Approve / deny stays human.
ais.prompt: Draft ready. I cannot send, pay, or bind anything. You stay in control.

queue.empty: Drop intake, a match note, a vetting app, a nudge, billing alert, or admin exception. Bind stays off. Collect stays HOLD.

dropHint: Name the intake, match, vetting item, nudge, billing alert, or admin exception. QIA drafts. You tap.

how.capture: Drop a quote request, agent application, unanswered thread, billing alert, or admin exception.
how.qualify: Check line of business, territory, credentials, and the 7-day vetting SLA.
how.do: Desk AIs draft the packet, match note, checklist, or exception. Dispatch and approve wait on Yes.
how.collect: Stripe tier / renewal and bind stay HOLD. Packs never charge or bind.
how.follow: One nudge or SLA reminder. Then stop. Nothing sends itself.

kpis: Time from quote request to first agent response
Agent vetting turnaround within 7 business days
Quote completion and quote-to-policy selection rate
API integration success rate and support tickets per active user
